description_en: Registers one or more SIP devices to specified agents in an instance. A SIP device can be a SIP phone or a SIP softphone
description_zh: 调用RegisterDevices注册一个或多个SIP设备到指定实例下的指定坐席，SIP设备可以是SIP话机或SIP软电话
kebab_example: aliyun ccc register-devices --instance-id ccc-test --user-id-list-json '["user-test@ccc-test"]' --device-id test-device --password password --api-version 2020-07-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: RegisterDevices

parameters.help_en: A JSON string that contains an array of agent IDs
parameters.help_zh: 座席ID列表，格式为JSON数组的字符串，数组元素是坐席ID
parameters.name: user_id_list_json

parameters.help_en: The device ID. Any string can be used, and there are no specific format requirements
parameters.help_zh: 设备ID，用户可自行设置，无特殊要求，字符串形式即可
parameters.name: device_id

parameters.help_en: The device password. The SIP device uses this password for authentication during registration. Store this password securely
parameters.help_zh: 设备密码，该密码用于在SIP设备发起注册信令时做鉴权校验，请妥善保管
parameters.name: password
